<module id="serial2parallel">
    <description>Serial-to-Parallel Converter</description>
    <ports>
        <input id="clk">Clock signal.</input>
        <input id="rst_n">Reset signal (active low).</input>
        <input id="din_serial">Serial input data.</input>
        <input id="din_valid">Validity signal for input data.</input>
        <output id="dout_parallel" width_description="[7:0]">Parallel output data (8 bits wide).</output>
        <output id="dout_valid">Validity signal for the output data.</output>
    </ports>
    <implementation>Sequential logic block triggered on the positive edge of clk or negative edge of rst_n.</implementation>
    <task id="reset_counter">
        <description>Resets the counter cnt to 0.</description>
        <implementation>Set cnt to 0.</implementation>
    </task>
    <task id="increment_counter">
        <description>Increments the counter cnt by 1.</description>
        <implementation>Add 1 to cnt.</implementation>
    </task>
    <task id="set_dout_parallel">
        <description>Sets the parallel output dout_parallel based on the current value of cnt.</description>
        <implementation>
            Assign dout_parallel[7-cnt] = din_serial;
        </implementation>
    </task>
    <task id="set_dout_valid">
        <description>Sets the dout_valid signal based on the value of cnt.</description>
        <implementation>
            if(cnt == 4'd7) begin
                dout_valid <= 1'b1;
            end else begin
                dout_valid <= 1'b0;
            end
        </implementation>
    </task>
    
    <logic_description type="sequential_logic">
        <reg id="cnt" width_description="[3:0]">Counter to keep track of the number of serial input data bits received.</reg>
        
        <always @("posedge clk or negedge rst_n") begin
            if(~rst_n) begin
                // Reset condition: Set cnt to 0 when rst_n is low
                reset_counter();
            end else begin
                // Sequential logic block triggered on the positive edge of clk
                if(din_valid) begin
                    // Increment the counter cnt by 1 when din_valid is high
                    increment_counter();
                    
                    // Update dout_parallel based on the current value of cnt
                    set_dout_parallel();
                    
                    // Update dout_valid based on the current value of cnt
                    set_dout_valid();
                end
            end
        end
    </logic_description>
</module>
